text.content:
This Path has grown in popularity in recent decades, with many young Setites attracted to its philosophies. Just as Set was once a hunter and warrior, so too are adherents of this Path. These Setites pride themselves upon their physical and martial prowess. Many who follow the Path of the Warrior are masochists and fanatics who believe that the Beast is a creation of the mind, and that by training the body until it is stronger than the mind, the Beast can be controlled.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Not subjecting yourself to the most painful tortures.
  2. Failing any test set you, physical or mental.
  3. Not developing your body to its fullest potential.
  4. Spending Blood Points to heal your wounds the same night they are inflicted.
  5. Not developing your Disciplines to their fullest potential.
  6. Killing swiftly and mercifully.
  7. Showing any sign of pain.
  8. Not exercising every night.
  9. Thinking too long before acting.
  10. Refusing a Physical Challenge.

Path Traits:

  • Failure — Frenzy if you fail in a conflict regarding the power of your mind or proving your superior physical prowess.
  • Mental or Physical Development — If you are unable to spend at least half an hour per night in meditation or developing your near-perfect immortal body, you are forced into a panic-driven frenzy.
  • Discipline Development — If you are not able to successfully use at least one each of your different Disciplines on a foe per night, you frenzy out of shame at your own weakness.
  • Pain — If you are caught showing any pain, knowing that you have failed Set causes you to frenzy.
  • Refusal — If you or any other Setite that you see backs down from a Physical Challenge, you frenzy due to the dishonor to your lord.
